scope: Fixed synthetic input per case, one program per row, confirmed shape-specific warp selection. Compilation, accuracy checks, and warmup excluded. Native torch.softmax is the optimized baseline; the readable reference is separate. Optional compiled reference uses default Inductor settings, independently of our kernel, with internal CUDA graphs disabled. Fullgraph errors stop the run; no eager fallback. Manual kernel selects 1/2 warps for three confirmed FP16 shapes on the pinned T4 stack; otherwise four. No model integration or exact-output guarantee.
